## Cost & Tokens — LLM spend health

Four panels showing what the agents are spending on Azure OpenAI and where the tokens go. All queries scope to `llm.*` dependencies (spans emitted by the `ai_ops_kit` `@traced_llm_call` decorator). Time range is controlled by the workbook's top-right time picker. A flat or gently rising cost curve is healthy; sudden steps usually mean a prompt change shipped or a model deployment shifted.

### Cumulative LLM cost (USD)

Total USD spend per hour, summed from `customDimensions["llm.total_cost_usd"]` on every `llm.*` span. A column chart so the per-bucket spend reads at a glance. Compare bucket heights to spot expensive hours; compare the trend to the same hour yesterday to spot regressions from a prompt change.

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "llm."
| extend cost = todouble(customDimensions["llm.total_cost_usd"])
| summarize sum(cost) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render columnchart

content.json:
### Token spend per minute

Sum of `customDimensions["llm.total_tokens"]` per 1-minute bucket. Higher resolution than the cost panel so you can pinpoint exactly when a load spike began. Token spend tracks closely with cost but is independent of price-per-1k changes — useful when reasoning about throughput separately from billing.

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "llm."
| extend tokens = toint(customDimensions["llm.total_tokens"])
| summarize sum(tokens) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| render timechart

content.json:
### Average cost per agent run

Mean LLM cost per agent run, computed by joining `llm.*` spans to their parent `agent.*` span on `operation_Id` (the OTel trace id). Sub-agent costs roll up under the supervisor's trace because LangGraph propagates the trace context. A rising line means each agent run is getting more expensive — either iteration counts crept up or a model upgrade kicked in.

content.query:
let llm_cost = dependencies
  | where name startswith "llm."
  | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions["llm.total_cost_usd"])
  | summarize total_cost = sum(cost) by operation_Id;
let agent_runs = dependencies
  | where name startswith "agent."
  | summarize started_at = min(timestamp) by operation_Id;
llm_cost
| join kind=inner agent_runs on operation_Id
| summarize avg(total_cost) by bin(started_at, 5m)
| render timechart

content.json:
### Tokens by model

Stacked bar chart of `llm.total_tokens` grouped by `customDimensions["llm.model_version"]`. Surfaces shifts in model mix — e.g., if a deployment swapped some traffic from `gpt-4o` to `gpt-4o-mini`, the stack composition changes visibly. Also catches accidental regressions where a code path pinned to a wrong model.

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "llm."
| extend tokens = toint(customDimensions["llm.total_tokens"]),
         model = tostring(customDimensions["llm.model_version"])
| summarize sum(tokens) by model, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render barchart kind=stacked
